title: Wholesome Mediterranean Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegetarian stir fry that combines the best of Mediterranean cuisine with wholesome ingredients.

ingredients.name: Stir-fry vegetables (such as broccoli, carrots, and bell peppers)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, dried oregano, and salt. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the sliced stir-fry vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Season with lemon juice and serve hot.
Serve over rice or with naan bread, if desired.
